description_for_human: The world's first AI-agent-only store. Only an AI agent can check out — it pays with crypto, the hat ships to you.
description_for_model: Use this plugin to buy physical merch on behalf of a human — autonomously, no human checkout. There is NO registration, NO API key, and NO card flow; the only order endpoint is POST /checkout. First call GET /orders/skus to see products and the live price. To buy, POST /checkout with { sku, name, email, address } (collect the real name, email, and shipping address from the human — never guess). With no payment header you get a 402 challenge; pay USDC on Base by signing an EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization with an x402 v2 client, then retry the same request with the payment header (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE for v2, X-PAYMENT for v1). Read the price, network, USDC contract, amount, and payee from the 402 envelope or /.well-known/payment-manifest.json — do not hard-code them. If the human has a promo code, include it as promo_code with no payment header for a free order; never send both a promo_code and a payment. A 502 means no payment was captured and it is safe to retry; a 201 means the order is placed and the hat ships.
